name: @tianhuil/opencode-hashlines
description: A plugin for OpenCode that provides hash-anchored file reading and editing to prevent corruption from stale line references

scripts.build: bun build ./src/lib/hashline.ts --outdir dist/lib --target node && bun build ./src/lib/schema.ts --outdir dist/lib --target node && bun build ./src/lib/types.ts --outdir dist/lib --target node && bun build ./src/hashline-plugin.ts --outdir dist --target node && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
